Punjab leaders summoned by Akal Takht over anti-sacrilege law

Punjab's Sikh ministers and MLAs have been summoned by the Akal Takht to appear on June 29 regarding an anti-sacrilege law. This summons follows a resolution by the SGPC seeking an FIR against Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann over a video row. The situation has also seen controversy over municipal elections and posters urging a boycott of the Chief Minister.
